title: Next.js vs WordPress: Which Is Better for Your Business Website?
metaTitle: Next.js vs WordPress for SEO & Business Websites | Helix24
metaDescription: Next.js vs WordPress compared for Kerala businesses: speed, SEO, security, editing and cost, with guidance on when each one is the right choice.
excerpt: WordPress and Next.js can both power a good business website. The right choice depends on how you will use the site, who will update it and how much you plan to spend on ads.
keyTakeaways: What each platform is and how they differ
How they compare on speed, SEO and security
How easy each one is to edit

sections.heading: What they are
paragraphs: WordPress is a content management system: you install it on a server, choose a theme and add plugins for extra features. Next.js is a framework for building custom websites in code, which can be connected to a separate content editor.

sections.heading: Speed and SEO
paragraphs: Both can rank well on Google. What matters is how fast the site loads on a phone, how clearly pages are structured and how good the content is.

A Next.js site can be pre-built into simple pages that load very quickly with little extra code. WordPress can also be fast, but heavy themes and many plugins often slow it down, so it needs more care.

sections.heading: Security and maintenance
paragraphs: WordPress needs regular updates to its core, theme and plugins. Outdated plugins are a common way sites get hacked, so someone should be responsible for updates.
A Next.js site has fewer moving parts and no public admin login by default, which reduces maintenance, though it still needs a developer for changes to layout or features.

sections.heading: Editing content
paragraphs: WordPress is familiar to many people and easy to edit straight away. A Next.js site can be connected to an editor such as Sanity or a simple CMS, so your team can update text, images and blog posts without touching code.

sections.heading: Which should you choose?
bulletPoints: Choose WordPress if you need a content-heavy site quickly, have someone to maintain it, and want to rely on existing plugins.
Choose Next.js if speed matters for your ads, you want a custom design, or you need the site to connect to other systems such as booking, CRM or payments.
For online stores, compare both with Shopify, which handles hosting and security for you.

callout.title: Judge the build, not just the platform
callout.text: A well-built WordPress site will beat a badly built Next.js site. Ask any developer to show you the speed of sites they have launched, tested on a phone.

faq.question: Is Next.js more expensive than WordPress?
faq.answer: A custom Next.js site usually costs more to build than a WordPress site using a ready-made theme, but can cost less to maintain. Compare the total over two or three years, including hosting, plugins and updates.

faq.question: Can I move my WordPress site to Next.js later?
faq.answer: Yes. Content can be migrated and old page addresses redirected so you keep your search rankings.
